prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web UI direction comp
Primary request: Create a 1600x1000 premium desktop web interface for COVENANT called "Timetable Slide Rack", designed as an institutional clearing-house departure board. This is a real web product screen, not a device mockup and not a poster.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed desktop application surface with an architectural dark-metal frame, bible-ivory working field, tinted glass panels, and raked mechanical timetable slides. The visual language should feel like a serious institutional clearing house, with disciplined depth, subtle shadows, real material joins, and a precise grid.
Subject: Express one complete causal finance story as six visibly connected timetable rows, in this exact order: "Sepolia payment", "Attestcoin proof", "Creditcoin verification", "CovenantSatisfied", "tranche draw", "replay rejected". Each row should read as a linked event in one auditable chain, with compact status, time, network or evidence details, and a continuous route or dependency indicator. Make the final "replay rejected" row visibly blocked and safe, not alarming.
Style/medium: High-fidelity premium web product UI, institutional finance, judge-ready, editorial precision, condensed typography, tactile mechanical slide rack, refined tinted glass, restrained industrial detailing.
Composition/framing: 1600x1000 landscape desktop viewport. Strong top header with COVENANT wordmark and navigation. Main content is a large angled timetable slide rack using most of the canvas. Include a concise facility summary integrated into the grid, not floating generic cards. Add a clear public evidence action. Use a coherent information hierarchy and generous but controlled whitespace.
Lighting/mood: Serious, calm, auditable, engineered. Soft directional light across glass and dark metal, readable contrast, no cinematic haze.
Color palette: goldenrod, slate, bible ivory, vermilion, bottle green, dark metal. Use vermilion only for rejection or critical emphasis, bottle green for verified or satisfied states, goldenrod for identity and primary action.
Materials/textures: tinted smoked glass, powder-coated dark metal, ivory paper-like inserts, machined rails, subtle raked slide depth.
Text (verbatim): "COVENANT"; navigation labels "Facility", "Evidence", "Policy", "Activity"; "10 CTC facility"; "4 CTC drawn"; "5 USDC payment"; button label "View public evidence"; event rows "Sepolia payment", "Attestcoin proof", "Creditcoin verification", "CovenantSatisfied", "tranche draw", "replay rejected".
Constraints: Render all required text legibly and verbatim. Keep the interface plausible and usable as a desktop web product. Make the six rows clearly connected in causal order. Show a finance-serious product with evidence provenance, statuses, and timestamps. No browser chrome. No device frame. No watermark.
Avoid: airport kitsch, split-flap nostalgia, travel icons, generic dashboard cards, crypto coins, token illustrations, fake charts, glassmorphism, neon gradients, purple-blue gradients, sci-fi HUD styling, excessive glow, marketing-poster composition, illegible microtext.
